propositions: Bedrock client construction fails with NoRegionError when REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION is unset because boto3 region resolution returns None in the container environment.
AWS_REGION alone does not resolve a region in botocore; only AWS_DEFAULT_REGION is consulted by the session's region-resolution chain.
IMDS reachability is independent of region discovery—IMDS supplies credentials but never a region, so fixing IMDS access does not resolve the NoRegionError.
The review-bot service must explicitly set AWS_DEFAULT_REGION in its environment to enable boto3 region resolution and prevent failures.
Pre-flight validation in build_bedrock_provider must detect missing region and raise a typed LLMConfigError naming REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION, not a bare boto3 NoRegionError.
CloudWatch voter metrics silently fail for the same reason as Bedrock client construction, so setting the region un-breaks both.
